IS and NO are licensable only through ADR-001's provisional reading of "the European Union" as Union membership. Both fall out of this grant if the licensor answers that the EEA is in scope, and the grant expires in three months so the reading lapses rather than standing indefinitely.

What each territory is for: CA holds the ca-east-006 object storage bucket, the worker identity and the reviewed publication path; IS is the only licensed source of the Blackwell architecture the NVFP4 text encoder targets. AU, IN, JP and NO widen placement capacity, and no further purpose is documented for them in this repository.

Outputs are written to Canadian object storage regardless of which territory the worker runs in, so placement and data residency are separate questions. This record settles the model licence only; it makes no data-residency finding.
